posts.author: Tony
posts.content_md:
Here are some pictures of my one of latest holography projects – no, it

isn’t a new emulsion or table setup – it was a total ‘makeover’ of the

downstairs ‘bathdarkroom’!

![Image](http://home.comcast.net/~stampydoo/both.jpg)

This was originally intended to be a simple ‘replace the vanity with a

bigger one’ swap, but ended up in a total makeover including paint,

flooring, the works! The best part is that it was wife-approved, so my

lease on the only room in the house that can be made completely dark has

been extended.
